notes.title: Update 07.12.2024
notes.notes:
New Features:

[list]
[*] The friends option is active, you can ask other players to be friends, and in the next update, you will also be able to chat with them and soon also build games together.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and support! We’re committed to making StartPlay even better for you! 🎮🎄

notes.title: Update 24.11.2024
notes.notes:
New Update for StartPlay Game.

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fix for Social Media Links: You can now add your social media links to the main menu you build for your game without any issues.
[*] Fix for LINK Object Creation: Resolved a bug related to creating a LINK object.
[*] Improved Button Navigation: Enhanced display when switching between buttons in pages like Settings and User Details.
[*] Avatar List Fix: Updated and improved the display of avatars in the list.
[/list]

New Features:

[list]
[*] Comments Page for Each Game: Each game now has a dedicated page where players can leave comments, share experiences, and connect with other players.
[*] Christmas-Themed Images: Added new Christmas-themed images, available for integration into your games.
[*] Christmas Background Music: You can now add festive background music to games related to Christmas to enhance the holiday spirit.
[/list]

Additional Enhancements:

Added the developer’s name to the opening page of the game to give proper credit.

Thank you for your feedback and support! We’re committed to making StartPlay even better for you! 🎮🎄

notes.title: Update 02.11.2024
notes.notes: This update brings important improvements to the game, including a fix for a bug affecting text display in door systems and a resolution for visual issues on certain computers. We’re dedicated to enhancing the gaming experience and will be releasing another update soon.

notes.title: 18.10.2024 : New Update for StartPlay
notes.notes:
The game update includes the following improvements and additions:

1.	Added 4 new languages to the learning system – now supporting a total of 20 languages.
2.	Added links to all our social media platforms within the game.
3.	Added 2 new triggers:
        - Enable rotation animation for models.
        - Disable rotation animation for models.
4.	Added support for Vulkan API, OpenGL Core and OpenGLES3 in addition to DX11 and DX12, improving compatibility with lower-end computers.

Bug fixes:

1.	Fixed a bug with the placeholder text in the UI settings for health.
2.	Fixed text in the door-opening code.
3.	Fixed a bug with NPC text display.
4.	Fixed a bug in the timed events for adding and reducing player power.

As always we continue to work on the next update that will be released in two weeks.

notes.title: 06.10.2024 : New Update for StatPlay
notes.notes:
[u][b]New Update for StatPlay![/b][/u]

We are excited to announce a new update!

What's new in this update:

[list]
[*] Introduced the ability to rotate models around a selected axis at a chosen speed.
[*] Added display settings on the main page.
[*] Fixed a bug related to adding 2D text.
[*] Removed the automatically created shortcut on the desktop.
[/list]

As always, we are continuously working on updates and improvements!
